name: The Anchors of Zephras
summary: On Zephras Isle, Halaan Hawk-Eye asks you to watch the ancient anchor pylons that hold the island aloft. Their magic has begun to waver, and the wind spirits' blessing may no longer be steady.

sections.title: Tethers of the Isle
sections.body: Wind spirits gave Zephras's ancient anchor pylons the power to bind and sustain the floating island. Their magic keeps the land steady amid the churning skies. From afar, the towering monoliths look untouched. Yet the island depends on the wind spirits' continuing blessing.

sections.title: A Disturbing Shift
sections.body: The anchor pylons look proud and undamaged, yet their magic has grown erratic. Halaan Hawk-Eye says the harmony that sustains them has become unstable and uncertain. No clear sign of physical harm appears. Those who watch over the groves have reason to fear what threatens the isle.

sections.title: Halaan's Gift
sections.body: Halaan Hawk-Eye cannot use skysight to peer between worlds, nor can he tap Zephras's deep ley lines. His gift is natural vision sharp enough to reach immense distances. He lends that sight to newcomers, so they can study the distant pylons and watch for changes in their homeland's fate.

faq.q: What are the anchor pylons on Zephras?
faq.answer: The anchor pylons are ancient structures the wind spirits gave to Zephras. They bind and sustain the island, keeping it stable above the surrounding world.

faq.q: What is wrong with the anchor pylons?
faq.answer: The pylons show no obvious physical damage, but their stabilizing magic has grown unstable and inconsistent. The cause remains unknown.
Halaan Hawk-Eye watches over the groves of Zephras Isle. His natural sight reaches great distances, and he watches over the land's well-being.
Halaan's gift is exceptionally sharp sight over great distances. It is natural vision, unlike skysight or the power to tap Zephras's deep ley lines.
Skysight is a mystical perception that lets certain practitioners peer between worlds, far beyond ordinary vision.

faq.q: Where does the magic powering the pylons come from?
faq.answer: The wind spirits gave the anchor pylons to Zephras. Halaan says they bind and sustain the island, but does not explain where their continuing power comes from.

angles.text: As a shaman, you know the wind spirits' blessing sustains the anchor pylons. Their unstable magic calls for an elemental's attention.
As a mage, you can recognize Halaan's keen eyesight as a natural gift.
